svg.aria-label: Theeraphat Chueanokkhum, full-stack and platform engineer in Chaiyaphum, Thailand. I build software from the interface down to the cluster, and stay to run it. Now: OCM, a nationwide oil-control platform for Thailand's Excise Department. An animated request travels down four layers and back: Interface (Next.js, Angular), Services (NestJS, FastAPI), Data (Oracle, PostgreSQL), Platform (Kubernetes, ArgoCD).
